group.title: Moving a presentation
group.passage:
Woman: The projector in Conference Room B won't turn on, and the client presentation starts at ten.
Man: Maintenance can't get here until eleven. Room D has a working projector, but it only seats eight.
Woman: There will be twelve of us. What about the training room on the third floor?
Man: It's free until noon and seats twenty. I'll move the reservation there.
Woman: Thanks. I'll send the revised location to the visitors. Could you also ask reception to direct anyone who misses the message?
Man: Certainly. I'll put a sign outside Room B as well.

男：那裡中午之前都空著，可以坐二十人。我會把預約改到那裡。
女：謝謝。我會把更新後的地點傳給來賓。你也可以請接待櫃檯替漏看訊息的人指路嗎？
男：當然。我也會在 B 會議室外放一個指示牌。
